arg.name: video_source
arg.description: Select the video source selection. Options are rosbag2 or camera

arg.name: rosbag2_path
arg.description: The directory path where the ros2 bag file is located

arg.name: rosbag2_topics
arg.description: Specifies the topics to play from the ros2 bag file. If you want to play all topics just leave it empty

arg.name: svo_path
arg.description: The directory path where the svo file is located. If you want to stream live with camera just leave it empty
